newsitem.title: USA: GB CEO Theisen resigns in Fidelity deal.
newsitem.headline: GB CEO Theisen resigns in Fidelity deal.

text.p: GB Foods Corp said on Monday that its chief executive and principal stockholder, William Theisen, had resigned his post and agreed to sell 1.0 million shares of common stock and 2.5 million common stock purchase warrants to Fidelity National Financial Inc.
In connection with the agreement with Fidelity, GB Foods said chief financial officer George Kubat had also resigned.
Of the 2.5 million warrants acquired by Fidelity from Theisen, 1.5 million are exercisable at $5.00 per share and 1.0 million are exercisable at $7.00 per share, GB Foods said in a statement.
Theisen retained roughly 270,000 shares and 500,000 of the $5.00 warrants.
William Foley, the chairman and chief executive officer of Fidelity, will take up a post on GB Foods' board of directors, the Mexican restaurant franchiser added.
Also in connection with the Fidelity agreement, the board of GB Foods adopted resolutions to redeem the company's stockholder rights plan at a redemption price of $.001 per share of common stock.
Fidelity is the parent corporation of seven national insurance underwriters.
